daily.today_energy: Your intuition is hitting different today, Pisces. The cosmos is whispering secrets just for you—lean into that inner knowing and trust the subtle nudges guiding you forward. Magic is real when you believe it.

daily.career: Your creative energy is immaculate right now. This is the time to pitch that idea you've been sitting on or approach a project from a fresh angle. Your unique perspective is literally your superpower.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness today. Consider what truly nourishes you—whether that's movement that feels good, rest that feels earned, or connection that feels real. Honor what your energy actually needs.
